en: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
fortify the frontiers of the Muslims through Thy might,
support their defenders through Thy strength,
and lavish upon them gifts through Thy wealth!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
increase their number, hone their weapons,
guard their territory, defend their midst,
unite their throng, arrange their affair,

ar: وَوَاتِرْ بَيْنَ مِيَرِهِمْ، وَتَوَحَّدْ بِكِفَايَةِ مَؤَنِهِمْ،
en: send them supplies in a steady string, undertake Thyself to suffice them with provisions,
support them with victory, help them with patience,
and give them subtlety in guile!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
give them the knowledge of that of which they are ignorant,
teach them what they do not know,
and show them what they do not see!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
make them forget when they meet the enemy
to remember this cheating and delusive world of theirs,

ar: وَامْحُ عَنْ قُلُوبِهِمْ خَطَرَاتِ الْمَالِ الْفَتُونِ،
en: erase from their hearts the thought of enchanting possessions,

ar: وَاجْعَلِ الْجَنَّةَ نَصْبَ أَعْيُنِهِمْ وَلَوِّحْ مِنْهَا لأِبْصَارِهِمْ
en: place the Garden before their eyes, and display to their sight that part of it

ar: مَا أَعْدَدْتَ فِيهَا مِنْ مَسَاكِنِ الْخُلْدِ وَمَنَازِلِ الْكَرَامَةِ
en: which Thou hast prepared for them - the homes of everlastingness and mansions of honour,

ar: وَالْحُورِ الْحِسَانِ وَالأَنْهَارِ الْمُطَّرِدَةِ بِأَنْوَاعِ الأَشْرِبَـةِ ،
en: the beautiful houris, the rivers gushing forth with all sorts of drinks,
the trees hanging, low with all kinds of fruits -

ar: حَتَّى لاَ يَهُمَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ بِالأدْبَارِ،
en: lest any of them think of turning his back

ar: وَلا يُحَدِّثَ نَفْسَهُ عَنْ قِرْنِهِ بِفِرَار.
en: or suggest to himself to flee his opponent!
O God, defeat their enemy through that,

ar: وَاقْلِمْ عَنْهُمْ أَظْفَارَهُمْ، وَفَرِّقْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَسْلِحَتِهِمْ ،
en: trim their nails from them, separate them from their weapons,

ar: وَاخْلَعْ وَثَائِقَ أَفْئِدَتِهِمْ، وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَزْوِدَتِهِمْ،
en: pull out the firm ties from their hearts, keep them far away from their stores,

ar: وَحَيِّرْهُمْ فِي سُبُلِهِمْ، وَضَلِّلْهُمْ عَنْ وَجْهِهِمْ،
en: bewilder them in their roads, turn them astray from their direction,

ar: وَاقْـطَعْ عَنْهُمُ الْمَدَدَ وَانْقُصْ مِنْهُمُ الْعَدَدَ،
en: cut off reinforcements from them, chop them down in numbers,

ar: وَامْلاْ أَفْئِدَتَهُمُ الرُّعْبَ، وَاقْبِضْ أَيْـدِيَهُمْ عَنِ البَسْطِ،
en: fill their hearts with terror, hold back their hands from stretching forth,
tie back their tongues from speaking,

ar: وَشَرِّدْ بهِمْ مَنْ خَلْفَهُمْ، وَنَكِّلْ بِهِمْ مَنْ وَرَاءَهُمْ،
en: "scatter by them the ones behind them" (8:57), make them a lesson for those beyond them,
and through their degradation cut off the hopes of those who come after them!
O God, make the wombs of their women barren
dry up the loins of their men,
cut off the breeding of their mounts and their cattle,

ar: لاَ تَأذَنْ لِسَمَائِهِمْ فِي قَطْر وَلاَ لارْضِهِمْ فِي نَبَات.
en: and permit not their sky to rain or their earth to grow!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَقَوِّ بِذَلِكَ مِحَالَّ أَهْلِ الإسْلاَمِ ،
en: O God, through that strengthen the prowess of the People of Islam,

ar: وَحَصِّنْ بِهِ دِيَارَهُمْ ، وَثَمِّرْ بِـهِ أَمْوَالَهُمْ ،
en: fortify their cities, increase their properties,

ar: وَفَرِّغْهُمْ عَنْ مُحَارَبَتِهِمْ لِعِبَادَتِكَ وَعَنْ مُنَابَذَتِهِمْ للْخَلْوَةِ بِكَ،
en: give them ease from their fighting to worship Thee and from their warfare to be alone with Thee,

ar: حَتَّى لا يُعْبَدَ فِي بِقَاعِ الارْضِ غَيْرُكَ
en: so that none will be worshipped in the regions of the earth but Thee

ar: وَلاَ تُعَفَّرَ لاَِحَد مِنْهُمْ جَبْهَةٌ دُونَكَ.
en: and no forehead of theirs may be rubbed in dust for less than Thee!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ اغزُ بِكُلِّ نَـاحِيَـة مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
en: O God, send out the Muslims of every region on raids
against the idolaters who face them!
Reinforce them with angels in ranks from Thee,

ar: حَتَّى يَكْشِفُـوهُمْ إلَى مُنْقَطَعِ التُّـرابِ قَتْـلاً فِي أَرْضِكَ
en: till the idolaters are routed by them to the end of the land, slain in Thy earth

ar: وَأَسْراً أَوْ يُقِرُّوا بِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ الَّذِي لاَ إلهَ إلاَّ أَنْتَ
en: or taken captive, or till they admit that Thou art God, other than whom there is no god,
Thou alone, who hast no associate!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَاعْمُمْ بِذَلِكَ أَعْدَاءَكَ فِي أَقْطَارِ الْبِلاَدِ
en: O God, include in this Thy enemies in the regions of the lands,

ar: مِنَ الْهِنْدِ وَالرُّومِ وَالتُّـرْكِ وَالْخَزَرِ وَالْحَبَشِ
en: the Indians, the Byzantines, the Turks, the Khazars, the Abyssinians,
the Nubians, the Zanjis, the Slavs, the Daylamites,

ar: وَسَائِرِ أُمَمِ الشِّرْكِ الَّذِي تَخْفَى أَسْمَاؤُهُمْ وَصِفاتُهُمْ،
en: and the rest of the idol-worshipping nations, those whose names and attributes are concealed,

ar: وَقَدْ أَحْصَيْتَهُمْ بِمَعْرِفَتِكَ، وَأَشْرَفْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِقُدْرَتِكَ.
en: but whom Thou countest in Thy cognizance and overseest through Thy power!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ اشْغَلِ الْمُشْرِكِينَ بِالمُشْرِكِينَ عَنْ تَنَاوُلِ أَطْرَافِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ،
en: O God, distract the idolaters from reaching for the borders of the Muslims through the idolaters,
bar them from cutting them down through being cut down,
and hold them back from massing together against them through dissension!
O God, empty their hearts of security

ar: وَأَبْدَانَهُمْ مِنَ الْقُوَّةِ وَأَذْهِلْ قُلُوبَهُمْ عَنِ الاحْتِيَالِ
en: and their bodies of strength, distract their hearts from thinking of stratagems,
make their limbs too feeble for clashing with men,
make them too cowardly for contending with champions,
send against them a troop of Thy angels

ar: بِبَأس مِنْ بَأْسِكَ كَفِعْلِكَ يَوْمَ بَدْر
en: with some of Thy severity as Thou didst on the Day of Badr,

ar: تَقْطَعُ بِهِ دَابِرَهُمْ وَتَحْصُدُ بِهِ شَوْكَتَهُمْ،
en: so that through it Thou mayest cut off their roots, harvest their thorns,
and disperse their number!

ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَامْزُجْ مِيَاهَهُمْ بِالْوَبَاءِ وَأطْعِمَتَهُمْ بِالأَدْوَاءِ
en: O God, mix their waters with pestilence and their foods with maladies,

ar: وَارْمِ بِلاَدَهُمْ بِالْخُسُوفِ وَأَلِـحَّ عَلَيْهَا بِـالْقُذُوفِ وَافْـرَعْهَا بِالْمُحُولِ.
en: hurl down their cities, harass them with peltings, hinder them through drought,

ar: وَاجْعَلْ مِيَرَهُمْ فِي أَحَصِّ أَرْضِكَ وَأَبْعَـدِهَا عَنْهُمْ،
en: place their supplies in the most ill-omened part of Thy earth and the farthest from them,

ar: وَامْنَـعْ حُصُونَهَا مِنْهُمْ، أَصِبْهُمْ بِالْجُوعِ الْمُقِيمِ وَالسُّقْمِ الالِيمِ.
en: bar them from its fortresses, and strike them with constant hunger and painful illness!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا غَاز غَزَاهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ مِلَّتِكَ
en: O God, if a warrior from the people of Thy creed wars against them

ar: أَوْ مُجَاهِد جَاهَدَهُمْ مِنْ أَتْبَاعِ سُنَّتِكَ لِيَكُونَ دِينُكَ الاعْلَى
en: or a struggler from the followers of Thy prescriptions struggles against them so that Thy religion may be the highest,

ar: وَحِزْبُكَ الأقوَى وَحَظُّكَ الأوْفَى فَلَقِّهِ الْيُسْرَ،
en: Thy party the strongest, and Thy share the fullest, cast ease to him,
arrange his affair, attend to him by granting success,

ar: وَتَخَيَّرْ لَهُ الأصْحَابَ، وَاسْتَقْوِ لَهُ الظَّهْرَ،
en: select for him his companions, strengthen his back,

ar: وَأَسْبِغْ عَلَيْهِ فِي النَّفَقَةِ وَمَتِّعْهُ بِالنَّشَاطِ،
en: lavish upon him livelihood, give him enjoyment of joyous vitality,

ar: وَأَطْفِ عَنْهُ حَرَارَةَ الشَّوْقِ، وَأَجِرْهُ مِنْ غَمِّ الْوَحْشَةِ،
en: cool for him the heat of yearning, give him sanctuary from the gloom of loneliness,

ar: وَأَنْسِهِ ذِكْرَ الاهْلِ وَالْوَلَدِ وَأَثُرْ لَهُ حُسْنَ النِّيَّةِ وَتَوَلَّه بِالْعَافِيَةِ،
en: make him forget the remembrance of wife and child, pass along to him an excellent intention, attend to him with well-being,
make safety his companion, release him from cowardice,

ar: وَأَلْهِمْهُ الْجُرْأَةَ وَارْزُقْهُ الشِّدَّةَ وَأَيِّدْهُ بِالنُّصْرَةِ،
en: inspire him with boldness, provide him with strength, support him with help,

ar: وَعَلِّمْهُ السِّيَرَ وَالسُّنَنَ، وَسَدِّدْهُ فِي الْحُكْمِ،
en: teach him right conduct and the norms of the Sunna, point him straight in judgement,

ar: وَاعْزِلْ عَنْهُ الرِّياءَ، وخَلِّصْهُ مِنَ السُّمْعَةِ
en: remove from him hypocrisy, purify him from seeking fame,

ar: وَاجْعَلْ فِكْرَهُ وَذِكْرَهُ وَظَعْنَهُ وَإقَامَتَهُ فِيْكَ وَلَكَ،
en: and make his thinking and remembrance, his departing and his staying, be in Thee and for Thee!

ar: فَإذا صَافَّ عَدُوَّكَ وَعَدُوَّهُ فَقَلِّلْهُمْ فِي عَيْنِهِ
en: When he stands in ranks before Thy enemy and his enemy, make them few in his eye,
diminish their importance in his heart,

ar: وَأَدِلْ لَهُ مِنْهُـمْ وَلاَ تُدِلْهُمْ مِنْهُ
en: give him a turn to prevail over them, not them a turn to prevail over him!

ar: فَإنْ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِالسَّعَادَةِ وَقَضَيْتَ لَهُ بِالشَّهَادَةِ
en: But if Thou sealest him with felicity and decreest for him martyrdom,
then let it be after he has exterminated Thy enemies by slaying,
captivity has afflicted them,
the borders of the Muslims are secure,
and Thy enemy has turned his back in flight!
O God, and if a Muslim should

ar: خَلَفَ غَازِياً أَوْ مُرَابِطاً فِي دَارِهِ
en: take the place of a warrior or a soldier in his home,
attend to those left behind in his absence,
help him with a portion of his property,

ar: أَوْ أَمَدَّهُ بِعِتَاد، أَوْ شَحَذَهُ عَلَى جِهَاد،
en: assist him with equipment, hone him for the struggle,
send along with him a supplication for his purpose,

ar: أَوْ رَعَى لَهُ مِنْ وَرَآئِهِ حُرْمَةً.
en: or guard his honour in his absence,
reward him with the like of his reward

ar: وَزْناً بِوَزْن وَمِثْلاً بِمِثْل وَعَوِّضْهُ مِنْ فِعْلِهِ
en: measure for measure, like for like, and recompense him for his act

ar: عِوَضاً حَاضِراً يَتَعَجَّلُ بِهِ نَفْعَ مَا قَدَّمَ،
en: with an immediate compensation through which he will hasten to the profit of what he has sent forth

ar: وَسُرُورَ مَا أَتَى به، إلَى أَنْ يَنْتَهِيَ بِهِ الْوَقْتُ
en: and the joy of what he has given, till the present moment takes him
to the bounty Thou hast granted to him
and the generosity Thou hast prepared for him!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا مُسْلِم أَهَمَّهُ أَمْرُ الإِسْلاَمِ
en: O God, and if the affair of Islam should worry a Muslim
and the alliance of the idolaters' against Islam should grieve him,
so that he has the intention to go to war and is about to enter the struggle,

ar: فَقَعَدَ بِـهِ ضَعْفٌ أَوْ أَبطَأَتْ بِهِ فَاقَةٌ،
en: but frailty keeps him seated, neediness keeps him waiting,
a mishap delays him,

ar: أَوْ عَرَضَ لَهُ دُونَ إرَادَتِهِ مَانِعٌ،
en: or an obstruction prevents him from his wish,
write his name among the worshipers,
make incumbent for him the reward of the strugglers,
and place him among the ranks of the martyrs and the righteous!

ar: أللَّهُمَّ صَـلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ
en: O God, bless Muhammad, Thy slave and Thy messenger,

ar: وَآلِ مُحَمَّد صَلاَةً عَالِيَةً عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ
en: and the Household of Muhammad, with a blessing high above all other blessings,
towering beyond all other salutations,
a blessing whose end is never reached
and whose number is never cut off,
like the most perfect of Thy blessings that has passed
to any one of Thy friends!
Thou art All-kind, Praiseworthy,
the Originator who takes back again,
Accomplisher of what Thou desirest.
